about: Film aliases (D-119): a source's film title, or the id it would make, to the film id it really is. scripts/pipeline.ts already treats titles that differ only in case or punctuation as one film, and joins a short title to the one longer film that is it plus a subtitle (that film's id); an alias settles the rest, or keeps a film's id steady. "ramayana-rise-of-a-legend" -> "ramayana": Lagocine lists Filmhouse's "Ramayana" and the others' "Ramayana: Rise of a Legend" (one film, TMDB 656908), and this keeps it at /film/ramayana, shown as "Ramayana", whichever spellings a run sees, so shared links keep working and the Figma example stays as drawn. Check each alias by hand. 17 Nov 2026 (D-122), once cinemas' own sites were read beside Lagocine: "Issakaba Returns" (Genesis), "Issakaba Return" (Silverbird's Veezi) and "Isakaba Return" (Blue Pictures) are Lagocine's "Isakaba: The Returns", one film; "TELE & ZIKORA" (Genesis) is "Tele X Zikora". "Maybe Or Maybe Not" (Silverbird Ikeja) is left apart from "Maybe… Maybe Not" until Chime checks it. 17 Nov 2026 (D-125), once the script-built sites were read: "AGBARANLA: THE RETURN" (Reach Cinema's sites, EbonyLife, THC; the remake of Mount Zion's 1991 Agbaranla) is Lagocine's "Agbara Nla: The Return"; Magnificent's "CLAY FACE" is "Clayface" and its "WHALE FALL" is "Whalefall".
